lines.en: -What is that? What are you supposed to be?
-A three-hole-punch version of Jim.
'Cause you can have me either way.
Playing white Jim or three-hole punch.
-That's great. -Oh, yeah.
-That's it. -Yeah, well, look, what about me?
-What are you? A monk?
-I'm a Sith Lord.
No big deal.
Three round pieces of paper taped to his shirt.
This cost me $129.
-Yes.
-This is called "Leveraging an Offer."
Michael, can I talk to you for a moment?
-Oh, good.
-I just thought you should know that I was just offered a job
with better pay, better benefits, and a better title at Cumberland Mills.
-Fantastic. -And I turned it down.
-What? That would have solved all my problems.
-Out of loyalty to this company. -Oh, you idiot.
-So I was hoping to be made assistant regional manager officially.
-If you left, I wouldn't have to fire anybody.
-But then you wouldn't have me here.
-Big deal. Oh, it would have worked out so well.
-Can you get it back?
-It's in Maryland.
-You can call. Can you call them?
-I can't. I suppose I -- no.
They never really made me an offer anyway.
-Why are you torturing me?
-Honestly, I don't think Michael has the slightest clue
of who he's gonna fire.
I think he keeps hoping that someone's gonna volunteer,
uh, or be run over by a bus before the deadline.
But in the end, really what's gonna happen is
it's gonna be the first person to give him a dirty look in the hall.
And therein lies the true essence of his charisma.
-Can I speak to you a minute?
-Um, yes.
Thank you.
